iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Al Jazeera reports Trump warning the US will not allow Iran to reach enriched uranium and will target anyone nearing monitored stockpiles; Reuters-linked reporting continues to frame the dispute around removal of enriched uranium. Tehran is still negotiating but rejects diplomacy terms requiring surrender of domestic enrichment. Active signals: nuclear rhetoric, 60% enrichment baseline, diplomacy active, diplomacy refused. Raw probability 48%. Rising/critical.

iran_conventional.name: Iran War
iran_conventional.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Just Security May 11 reports Iran warned attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz would bring heavy assault on US ships, and Trump rejected Iran proposal as unreasonable. Al Jazeera/PBS/CENTCOM-source reporting from May 7-8 still shows US-Iran naval fire, disabled tankers, and ceasefire violation claims. Hormuz restricted, not closed. Active signals: Hormuz restricted, ceasefire violation, military buildup, diplomacy active, diplomacy refused. Raw probability 86%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Al Jazeera May 9 reports Israeli attacks across Lebanon killed at least 24 despite a US-brokered ceasefire, after earlier Israeli strikes hit Beirut and southern/eastern Lebanon. Diplomatic talks exist but strikes despite ceasefire and persistent military buildup dominate. Raw probability 52%. Stable/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey Nato

india.name: India Pakistan
india.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: BBC/AP/AA reporting around the one-year anniversary says the India-Pakistan ceasefire holds, though the equilibrium remains brittle. russia.name: Russia Nato
russia.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Search found no fresh Article 5 contact or direct NATO-Russia kinetic trigger. china.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Taiwan and Japan-region reporting continues to emphasize Chinese blockade rehearsal risk and Taiwan drills to secure energy routes, but no fresh invasion or quarantine order surfaced. Active signal: military buildup. Raw probability 22%. Stable/elevated.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Search still centers on April projectile launches and generic warnings of possible additional tests; no fresh atomic-device event surfaced. Active signal: missile launch risk. Raw probability 14%. Stable/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Reuters/US News and Al Jazeera report Russia and Ukraine trading drone/artillery accusations and battlefield clashes despite ceasefire windows. Diplomacy active remains, but military buildup and noncompliance dominate. Raw probability 82%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Results include weak/open-source references to Afghanistan-Pakistan border fighting but no high-confidence fresh Reuters/AP trigger in the last day. Late-April/early-May border military buildup is carried forward, balanced by diplomacy active. Raw probability 24%. Falling/elevated.

sudan.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Sudan remains configured after RSF drone/infrastructure strikes on Khartoum and Port Sudan earlier this month; no new Red Sea maritime escalation surfaced today. Active signal: infrastructure_strike. Raw probability 17%. Stable/elevated.
